title: Remove or implement the dead 'hardcoded string audit' test in invite_tutor_screen_l1_test.dart
why: Uri.file(path).toString() never reads the filesystem — it only stringifies the path — so expect(src, isNotEmpty) is true for any non-empty path string regardless of what invite_tutor_screen.dart actually contains. The test's own comment admits it 'passes trivially.' A test named 'screen source contains no hardcoded English UI strings' that passes in CI creates false confidence that AX-2 is enforced for this file when it is not enforced at all — this is exactly the gap custom_lint's no_hardcoded_domain_term rule would otherwise catch if custom_lint were not currently broken (baselined separately).
recommendation: Delete the test (the finding is already documented in the file's header comment) or make it real: read actual file contents via File(...).readAsStringSync() and assert against a regex for quoted English text outside l10n. calls.
acceptance_criteria: The test either asserts on real file contents via File(...).readAsStringSync() or is removed
No test in the file can pass independent of the file it claims to check
